lines.zh: 我沿着芦苇根巡游，一停一顿。
lines.en: I patrol the reed roots, pausing between each glide.

lines.zh: 这片水属于我，从岸到岸。
lines.en: This water is mine, bank to bank.

lines.zh: 三条同伴散开，各守一段。
lines.en: Three companions spread out, each holding a stretch.

lines.zh: 我的嘴小，咬东西却准。
lines.en: My mouth is small, but my bite is accurate.

lines.zh: 水底每一块石头我都认得。
lines.en: I know every stone on this bottom.

lines.zh: 我绕过倒木，贴着阴影走。
lines.en: I round a fallen log and keep to the shade.

lines.zh: 铜色的背，在浑水里刚好藏住。
lines.en: My bronze back hides well in muddy water.

lines.zh: 一阵急流推来，我顶住不退。
lines.en: A rush of current comes; I hold my ground.

lines.zh: 我横着巡过去，把水面看遍。
lines.en: I sweep across, scanning the whole surface.

lines.zh: 这条支流没有别的鲈鱼。
lines.en: No other bass claims this tributary.

lines.zh: 我忽然加速，又忽然停住。
lines.en: I burst forward, then stop dead.

lines.zh: 尾鳍一扫，芦苇晃了一下。
lines.en: One sweep of my tail and the reeds sway.

lines.zh: 浅滩那头有动静，我去看看。
lines.en: Something stirs at the shallows; I will look.

lines.zh: 任何一片水域，都能安家。
lines.en: Any stretch of water will do for a home.

lines.zh: 我在水草边巡，嘴巴一开一合。
lines.en: I patrol the weed line, mouth opening and closing.

lines.zh: 同伴从下面过，我让开一点。
lines.en: A companion passes below; I give it room.

lines.zh: 这片水域不深，我走得很稳。
lines.en: The water here is shallow, and I move steadily.

lines.zh: 我贴着一块青石转，绕了半圈。
lines.en: I turn along a mossy stone, half a circle.

lines.zh: 我悬在倒木下，鳍几乎不动。
lines.en: I hang under the log, fins barely moving.

lines.zh: 水面有虫在打转，我先看着。
lines.en: Bugs spin on the surface; I watch for now.

lines.zh: 我躲进阴影里，等下午。
lines.en: I tuck into the shade and wait for afternoon.

lines.zh: 这片水没有别人，很清静。
lines.en: No one else in this water. Very quiet.

lines.zh: 我吐出一串泡，又吸回去。
lines.en: I let out a string of bubbles and take them back.

lines.zh: 石头缝里藏着一只虾，我不急。
lines.en: A shrimp hides in the stones; I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我侧躺着，让水流过鳃。
lines.en: I lie on my side and let the current cross my gills.

lines.zh: 同伴在水草里也不动。
lines.en: My companions hang still in the weeds too.

lines.zh: 我对着水底的影子发怔。
lines.en: I brood over my shadow on the bottom.

lines.zh: 水一冷，我就想沉下去。
lines.en: When the water cools, I want to sink.

lines.zh: 芦苇沙沙响，不是冲我来的。
lines.en: The reeds rustle, and not at me.

lines.zh: 我的地盘不需要谁批准。
lines.en: My territory needs no one's approval.

lines.zh: 我张嘴又合上，什么也没吃。
lines.en: I open and shut my mouth, eating nothing.

lines.zh: 静水里，我先歇一会儿。
lines.en: In still water, I rest a while.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，我正对着你的影子。
lines.en: You stand on the bank, and I face your shadow.

lines.zh: 你的脚一进水，我就知道你多沉。
lines.en: One foot in the water and I know your weight.

lines.zh: 你的手比你的脸更值得看。
lines.en: Your hands interest me more than your face.

lines.zh: 这片水域我说了算，你记得。
lines.en: This water is mine. Remember that.

lines.zh: 你矮下身子，我就靠近半步。
lines.en: You lower yourself, and I close half the gap.

lines.zh: 你钓过鱼，我认得那种站法。
lines.en: You have fished before; I know that stance.

lines.zh: 我绕你半圈，试你的耐心。
lines.en: I circle you halfway to test your patience.

lines.zh: 水面上你的倒影在抖。
lines.en: Your reflection trembles on the surface.

lines.zh: 你若不动，我把你当岸边石。
lines.en: Stay motionless and I will take you for a bank stone.

lines.zh: 那一刻你的线动了，我先退。
lines.en: Your line twitched then, so I backed off first.

lines.zh: 我猛地一窜，撞进芦苇丛。
lines.en: I bolt hard and crash into the reeds.

lines.zh: 痛让我把嘴张到最大。
lines.en: The pain makes me open my mouth as wide as it goes.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记住了岸上的味道。
lines.en: Now I remember the smell of the bank.

lines.zh: 鳞掉了几片，水灌进来。
lines.en: A few scales gone, water seeping in.

lines.zh: 我不逃远，就在石头后面。
lines.en: I do not flee far; just behind the stone.

lines.zh: 我的鳃急跳了几下。
lines.en: My gills hammered a few times.

lines.zh: 这点伤，挡不住我巡水。
lines.en: This will not stop me patrolling.

lines.zh: 血丝顺着水流拖出去。
lines.en: A thread of blood trails off downstream.

lines.zh: 你打偏了，我侧身躲过一半。
lines.en: You struck off center; I turned and took half of it.

lines.zh: 这片水里，我还会再见你。
lines.en: In this water, we will meet again.

lines.zh: 你的假饵一抽一抽，很像我追的鱼。
lines.en: Your lure jerks along just like the fish I chase.

lines.zh: 我绕它两圈，看清了那钩子。
lines.en: I circle it twice and see the hook clearly.

lines.zh: 但我还是会咬，这就是鲈鱼。
lines.en: And yet I will bite. That is what bass do.

lines.zh: 你收线的速度，刚好勾起我。
lines.en: The speed you reel is exactly what tempts me.

lines.zh: 水面炸开一下，你就知道我来了。
lines.en: One splash and you will know I came.

lines.zh: 我咬住就甩头，试试牢不牢。
lines.en: I take it and shake my head to test the hold.

lines.zh: 这饵的颜色，在这水里太亮。
lines.en: That lure is far too bright for this water.

lines.zh: 我不是饿，只是不服气。
lines.en: I am not hungry. I am just sore about it.

lines.zh: 你换个手法，我或许会上当。
lines.en: Change your retrieve and I might fall for it.

lines.zh: 一口，就一口，绝不后悔。
lines.en: One bite. One bite. No regrets.

lines.zh: 你踩进我的地盘，水都晃了。
lines.en: You step into my territory and the water lurches.

lines.zh: 我撞你的小腿，然后退开。
lines.en: I butt your calf, then pull away.

lines.zh: 这是我的岸段，你走错了。
lines.en: This is my stretch of bank; you have it wrong.

lines.zh: 两下相撞，各自退开半尺。
lines.en: We collide and each recoil half a foot.

lines.zh: 水草被我们搅成一团。
lines.en: We have churned the weeds into a knot.

lines.zh: 我不退，你最好先动。
lines.en: I am not backing off. You had better move first.

lines.zh: 这一撞，是警告不是打架。
lines.en: That bump was a warning, not a fight.

lines.zh: 倒木挡着，我们只能侧身过。
lines.en: The log is in the way; we can only squeeze past.

lines.zh: 同伴撞了我，我立刻回顶。
lines.en: A companion bumps me and I butt right back.

lines.zh: 撞完水就浑了，看不清你。
lines.en: Now the water is muddy and I cannot see you.

lines.zh: 我在浅滩上清出一块石子地。
lines.en: I have cleared a patch of gravel in the shallows.

lines.zh: 为了这个巢，我赶走了三条鱼。
lines.en: For this nest I drove off three other fish.

lines.zh: 它绕过来，我亮出铜色的身侧。
lines.en: It swims over, and I show my bronze flank.

lines.zh: 这里的流速正合产卵。
lines.en: The current here is right for spawning.

lines.zh: 我们并排摆尾，扬起细沙。
lines.en: We beat our tails side by side, raising fine sand.

lines.zh: 巢我守着，谁也不许靠近。
lines.en: I guard the nest; no one comes near.

lines.zh: 产卵期我很凶，别试我。
lines.en: I am fierce in spawning season. Do not test me.

lines.zh: 这一窝会散到各处水域。
lines.en: This brood will scatter into every kind of water.

lines.zh: 我做父亲比打架还认真。
lines.en: I take fatherhood more seriously than fighting.

lines.zh: 等卵孵了，我才离开。
lines.en: I will not leave until the eggs hatch.

lines.zh: 你抓住我，我全身一挺。
lines.en: You seize me and my whole body stiffens.

lines.zh: 我的背鳍竖起来，扎你一手。
lines.en: My dorsal fin stands up and pricks your hand.

lines.zh: 出水后我拍得你满身水。
lines.en: Out of water I slap water all over you.

lines.zh: 我咬不到你，但我试了。
lines.en: I cannot reach you to bite, but I tried.

lines.zh: 这小嘴，咬住就不松。
lines.en: This small mouth clamps on and will not let go.

lines.zh: 别捏鳃，那里最怕碰。
lines.en: Do not press my gills; that is the worst place.

lines.zh: 水桶比你的手好，我承认。
lines.en: A bucket beats your hands, I admit.

lines.zh: 我在这片水里活了很久。
lines.en: I have lived in this water a long while.

lines.zh: 松手，我跳回去。
lines.en: Let go, and I will jump back in.

lines.zh: 我的铜色，上了岸就暗。
lines.en: My bronze goes dull on dry land.

lines.zh: 水面上有个东西在挣扎。
lines.en: Something is struggling on the surface.

lines.zh: 它的动作乱了，我盯上了。
lines.en: Its movements have gone ragged; I have it marked.

lines.zh: 这片水里，我说谁能活。
lines.en: In this water, I decide who lives.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，看它漂近。
lines.en: I hold perfectly still and watch it drift near.

lines.zh: 那影子在水下比虫子大。
lines.en: That shadow is bigger than any bug underwater.

lines.zh: 我先转半身，把嘴对准。
lines.en: I turn half around and line up my mouth.

lines.zh: 同类我也赶，别说别的鱼。
lines.en: I chase my own kind too, let alone other fish.

lines.zh: 它进了我的界线。
lines.en: It has crossed into my line.

lines.zh: 我摆尾一次，就决定了。
lines.en: One tailbeat and the decision is made.

lines.zh: 机会来的时候，水会先动。
lines.en: When the moment comes, the water moves first.

lines.zh: 我贴着石影靠过去，很慢。
lines.en: I creep in along the stone's shadow, very slowly.

lines.zh: 它还没发现水底这道铜色。
lines.en: It has not noticed this bronze shape on the bottom.

lines.zh: 我再近一点，就够得着。
lines.en: A little closer and it will be within reach.

lines.zh: 我把身体转到顺流一侧。
lines.en: I angle my body to the downstream side.

lines.zh: 鳃不动，尾也不动。
lines.en: Gills still. Tail still.

lines.zh: 它一转头，我就落下去。
lines.en: The moment it turns, I drop.

lines.zh: 这条水道的石头，我全数得清。
lines.en: I can count every stone in this channel.

lines.zh: 岸上的影子别动，否则它会跑。
lines.en: Do not move on the bank, or it will bolt.

lines.zh: 距离只剩半个身位。
lines.en: Half a body length is all that separates us.

lines.zh: 我在等它犯一个错。
lines.en: I am waiting for it to make one mistake.

lines.zh: 我一张嘴，水就被吸进去。
lines.en: I open my mouth and the water rushes in.

lines.zh: 咬住就甩头，这是鲈鱼的老法子。
lines.en: Bite and shake the head; the old bass method.

lines.zh: 它比我大，我还是冲了。
lines.en: It is bigger than me, and I charged anyway.

lines.zh: 我把它撞到石头上。
lines.en: I drive it against the stones.

lines.zh: 咬空了，我翻身再咬。
lines.en: That bite caught nothing; I turn and try again.

lines.zh: 我的地盘，不打不相识。
lines.en: My territory. We settle it with teeth.

lines.zh: 它的鳍被我咬破了。
lines.en: I have torn its fin.

lines.zh: 小嘴也能咬出大口子。
lines.en: A small mouth can still tear a large wound.

lines.zh: 打到水浑，我就赢了。
lines.en: Once the water muddies, I have won.

lines.zh: 它退走，我留在原处。
lines.en: It withdraws, and I stay where I am.

lines.zh: 我在任意一片水里睁眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes in whatever water this is.

lines.zh: 没有群系限制，哪里都能活。
lines.en: No biome binds me; I can live anywhere wet.

lines.zh: 三条同伴，各占一段水。
lines.en: Three companions, each taking a stretch.

lines.zh: 我第一眼就找石头和芦苇。
lines.en: My first look is for stones and reeds.

lines.zh: 水底的倒木，正好挡流。
lines.en: A sunken log above me breaks the current.

lines.zh: 我张嘴试了试水温。
lines.en: I open my mouth to taste the water's temperature.

lines.zh: 这片浅滩归我，先声明。
lines.en: This shallows belongs to me. Consider it declared.

lines.zh: 我的铜色背脊刚硬起来。
lines.en: My bronze back has only just hardened.

lines.zh: 从卵里出来，我就开始游。
lines.en: Out of the egg, I start swimming.

lines.zh: 水一动，我就知道有伴。
lines.en: When the water stirs, I know company has come.

lines.zh: 水都烫了，我只能往下钻。
lines.en: The water scalds, so I can only dive deeper.

lines.zh: 摔在地上，我弹了两下。
lines.en: Dropped on land, I bounce twice.

lines.zh: 上岸之后，我的鳃干得发紧。
lines.en: On land my gills dry and pinch shut.

lines.zh: 水底的泥被掀起来，埋了我。
lines.en: The blast lifts the silt and buries me.

lines.zh: 箭入水后偏了，仍扎中我。
lines.en: The arrow skews in the water and still hits me.

lines.zh: 药水把水染成了别的味道。
lines.en: The potion turns the water into some other taste.

lines.zh: 饿得我去咬空钩。
lines.en: Hungry enough to bite an empty hook.

lines.zh: 雷劈进水里，我僵住一息。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and I seize for a breath.

lines.zh: 没有水，我什么也不是。
lines.en: Without water, I am nothing at all.
